data.body: Patch set 5 pushed to Gerrit change 2592 after rebasing onto current origin/main (6125c5345f01) to pick up the scanner-integration workflow support files required by CI. Local post-rebase validation: targeted policy docs test passed; ADR number/index checks passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed; verify-commit-ticket passed. Local scanner lock validation passed, while full scanner-integration is not runnable on this macOS arm64 host because the target supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only. Previous patch set 4 CI failures were classified: scanner job was a build/config failure from missing scripts on the stale base, and pytest failure was the already-observed xdist worker crash in tests/e2e/test_editor_e2e.py.
